*"an authored `hideEmpty` of either polarity is now inert"* at write-time ref `1f31d3af6` vs `origin/main`:

| probe | `1f31d3af6` (write time) | `origin/main` today |

The dev extended the `7129` dated note to cover the adjacent *"the unauthored default is unchanged"*, declaring it a bounded in-place fix. **Verified, and it was necessary**: `packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/record-details.tsx:653` reads `hideEmpty: s.hideEmpty ?? true`, so an **unauthored** section now defaults to hiding when all-empty. ⇒ the unauthored default did **not** stay unchanged, and leaving that half standing would have published a dated note beside a live falsehood in the same paragraph. **[ABSENT CTRL]** on the same file: 0.

The `7064` note's scope limit is right for the same reason and from the same reading: the `?? true` sits inside the `sections` map, so the direct-`fields` fallback body and the `detail-view` node — which author no section — are genuinely untouched.

But the identical sentence lives in the **squash commit message on `main`**, which is immutable. Editing the PR body alone would put the two copies out of step and would publish nothing. ⇒ **named, not touched** is the correct disposition, and stating the reachability limit is worth more than a cosmetic edit.
